title: Tom Petty and the Heartbreakers 50th Anniversary Countdown: Vote for Your Favorite Songs
summary: Tune in to the entire 50-song countdown throughout Labor Day weekend on Tom Petty Radio.
body_markdown:
This Labor Day weekend,[Tom Petty Radio (Ch. 31)](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/tom-petty-radio) is celebrating 50 years of Tom Petty and the Heartbreakers with a listener-voted countdown. But first — we need your help!


[Tom Petty Radio Greatest hits, exclusive shows & more Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/tom-petty-radio)


**Directions:** Select up to 10 Tom Petty and the Heartbreakers songs from the list below from now through Monday, August 31.


Then, tune in to the entire 50-song “Tom Petty and the Heartbreakers 50th Anniversary Countdown” throughout Labor Day weekend (September 4-7) on Tom Petty Radio. The full special will also be available to stream on the[SiriusXM app](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/tom-petty-radio) after it premieres.
